  AnswerQuestion(id, option string) (OperatorDecision, error)
  RetireQuestion(id string) (OperatorRetirement, error)
  ReadAttributedQuestion(id string) (AttributedQuestion, error)
  ReadChoiceDetails(id string) (ChoiceDetails, error)
  ReadQuestionAsker(id string) (QuestionAsker, error)
  AnswerQuestionIfPending(id, option string) (OperatorDecision, error)

func (PermissionOperatorDispatcher) ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
type NotificationApplication interface
  Post(request NotificationRequest) (NotificationObservation, error)
  Observe(requestRef RequestRef, waitMs int64) (NotificationObservation, error)
  Withdraw(requestRef RequestRef) (NotificationObservation, error)
  Acknowledge(requestRef RequestRef, result_ NotificationResult) (ChoiceAcknowledgement, error)
type NotificationApplicationTransport interface
  FrameExchanger
type NotificationApplicationClient struct
func NewNotificationApplicationClient(t NotificationApplicationTransport) *NotificationApplicationClient
type NotificationApplicationDispatcher struct
  Handler NotificationApplication
func (NotificationApplicationClient) Post(request NotificationRequest) (result NotificationObservation, err error)
func (NotificationApplicationClient) Observe(requestRef RequestRef, waitMs int64) (result NotificationObservation, err error)
func (NotificationApplicationClient) Withdraw(requestRef RequestRef) (result NotificationObservation, err error)
func (NotificationApplicationClient) Acknowledge(requestRef RequestRef, result_ NotificationResult) (result ChoiceAcknowledgement, err error)
func (NotificationApplicationDispatcher) DescribeService() (contract string, ready bool, why string)
func (NotificationApplicationDispatcher) DescribeServiceMetadata() (guarantees []string, capabilities map[string]string)
func (NotificationApplicationDispatcher) ServiceContract() string
func (NotificationApplicationDispatcher) WriteFrame(frame []byte) error
func (NotificationApplicationDispatcher) ExchangeFrame(frame []byte) ([]byte, error)
type NotificationOperator interface
  ListNotifications(cursor string, limit int64) (NotificationPage, error)
  ReadNotification(id string) (NotificationRead, error)
  Act(id, action, presentation string) (NotificationDecision, error)
  Dismiss(id string) (NotificationDecision, error)
  WithdrawProgram(program string) (NotificationDecision, error)
  ListNotifiers(cursor string, limit int64) (NotifierPage, error)
type NotificationOperatorTransport interface
  FrameExchanger
type NotificationOperatorClient struct
func NewNotificationOperatorClient(t NotificationOperatorTransport) *NotificationOperatorClient
type NotificationOperatorDispatcher struct
  Handler NotificationOperator
